001package io.github.ai4ci.config;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
008
009import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Abstraction;
010
011/**
012 * Configuration for running a set of experiments as a batch job. This auto
013 * detects if the job is running in the context of a SLURM multi-node batch job
014 * and if so provides a mechanism to subset the overall configuration depending
015 * on the number of SLURM nodes involved. This means that the instance of
016 * JPanSim2 running on one SLURM node does not repeat the work done by others.
017 * It also prevents SLURM nodes from overwriting each others outputs by
018 * providing node specific output directories.
019 */
020@Value.Immutable
021@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableBatchConfiguration.class)
022@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableBatchConfiguration.class)
023public interface BatchConfiguration extends Abstraction.Described {
024
025        /**
026         * A sensible default batch configuration used in examples and tests.
027         *
028         * <p>
029         * The default values provide a compact set of parameters used as a baseline
030         * in examples and tests. Downstream callers that rely on this simple default
031         * include example experiments.
032         *
033         * @see io.github.ai4ci.example.Experiment
034         */
035        ImmutableBatchConfiguration DEFAULT = ImmutableBatchConfiguration.builder()
036                .setSimulationDuration(200)
037                .setUrnBase("default")
038                .setExporters(
039                        Exporters.DEMOGRAPHICS,
040                        Exporters.SUMMARY,
041                        Exporters.INFECTIVITY_PROFILE,
042                        Exporters.FINAL_STATE,
043                        Exporters.BEHAVIOUR,
044                        Exporters.CONTACT_COUNTS,
045                        Exporters.POST_VACCINATION,
046                        Exporters.VIRAL_CHALLENGE
047                )
048                .build();
049        String NOT_SLURM = "NOT_SLURM";
050
051        // static Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BatchConfiguration.class);
052
053        /**
054         * Gets the batch name, which is a combination of the batch number and total
055         * number of batches. This is useful for identifying the specific batch job
056         * when running multiple batches in parallel.
057         *
058         * @return The batch name in the format "batchNumber/batchTotal".
059         */
060        @JsonIgnore @Value.Derived
061        default String getBatchName() {
062                return this.getBatchNumber() + "/" + this.getBatchTotal();
063        }
064
065        /**
066         * Default value will populate from the SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID environment
067         * variable. Only set this if you know what you are doing
068         *
069         * @return The batch number, which is the index of the current job in the
070         *         SLURM array. If not running in a SLURM batch job, it defaults to
071         *         1.
072         */
073        @JsonIgnore @Value.Derived
074        default int getBatchNumber() {
075                var tmp = System.getenv("SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID"); // will be set to the
076                                                                                                                                                // job array index
077                                                                                                                                                // value or null.
078                if (tmp != null) {
079                        var t = Integer.parseInt(tmp);
080                        if (t == 0) { t = this.getBatchTotal(); }
081                        return t;
082                }
083
084                return 1;
085        }
086
087        /**
088         * Default value will populate from the SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT environment
089         * variable. Only set this if you know what you are doing
090         *
091         * @return The total number of batches, which is the total number of jobs in
092         *         the SLURM array. If not running in a SLURM batch job, it defaults
093         *         to 1.
094         */
095        @JsonIgnore @Value.Derived
096        default int getBatchTotal() {
097                var tmp = System.getenv("SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT"); // will be set to
098                                                                                                                                                        // the number of
099                                                                                                                                                        // tasks in the job
100                                                                                                                                                        // array or null.
101                if (tmp != null) return Integer.parseInt(tmp);
102                return 1;
103        }
104
105        /**
106         * Gets the list of exporters to be used in the simulation.
107         *
108         * @return An array of exporters.
109         */
110        @Value.Default
111        default Exporters[] getExporters() {
112                return new Exporters[] { Exporters.DEMOGRAPHICS, Exporters.SUMMARY,
113                                Exporters.INFECTIVITY_PROFILE, Exporters.LINELIST,
114                                Exporters.FINAL_STATE };
115        }
116
117        /**
118         * Gets the duration of the simulation.
119         *
120         * @return The simulation duration in time units.
121         */
122        int getSimulationDuration();
123
124        /**
125         * Gets the base URN for the batch configuration.
126         *
127         * @return The base URN as a string.
128         */
129        @Value.Default
130        default String getUrnBase() { return ""; }
131
132        @JsonIgnore @Value.Default
133        default String getLocalDir() {
134                return System.getenv("LOCALDIR") == null ? NOT_SLURM
135                        : System.getenv("LOCALDIR");
136        }
137
138        /**
139         * Checks if the current execution is part of a SLURM array job by looking
140         * for the presence of the SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID environment variable.
141         *
142         * @return true if the SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID environment variable is set,
143         *         indicating that the code is running as part of a SLURM batch job;
144         *         false otherwise.
145         */
146        @JsonIgnore @Value.Derived
147        default boolean isSlurmBatch() {
148                return System.getenv("SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID") != null;
149        }
150
151        /**
152         * Checks if the current execution is part of a SLURM job by looking for the
153         * presence of the SLURM_JOB_ID environment variable.
154         *
155         * @return true if the SLURM_JOB_ID environment variable is set, indicating
156         *         that the code is running as part of a SLURM job; false otherwise.
157         */
158        @JsonIgnore @Value.Derived
159        default boolean isSlurmJob() {
160                return System.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID") != null;
161        }
162
163        /**
164         * The SLURM job id
165         *
166         * @return the SLURM_JOB_ID environment variable.
167         */
168        @JsonIgnore @Value.Derived
169        default String getSlurmId() {
170                return System.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID") == null ? NOT_SLURM
171                        : System.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID");
172        }
173}
